pairs.question: Quae tria? an ea quae mihi here dixisti de pastoricia re?
pairs.answer: Ista quae coeperat hic disserere, quae esset origo, quae dignitas, quae ars.
pairs.derivation: Murrius asks which three topics were meant; 'ille' (Cossinius) answers by enumerating them (origo, dignitas, ars). Dropped the speech tags 'inquit Murrius' and 'inquit ille' as framing/narration. The answer ends at the enumeration; immediately after 'ars' the text has a lacuna marker (***) then a new speaker ('Ego vero, inquam, dicam...'), which is excluded; trailing '***' stripped and a terminal stop normalized in place of the comma.
